scientific_integrity: General proof combines the published maturity theorem and an independently reconstructed signed equivariant Euler-chain computation; computational cross-check is reproducible using a standard-library script. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Rational representations for two ordered collision-free points on K_{p,q}, p,q >= 3; the bipartition-preserving S_p x S_q action and particle exchange only. No additional color-class-swapping automorphism, integral representation lattice, fundamental group, cohomology ring, or higher-particle classification. The finite computations corroborate the general proof and do not replace it. Balanced diagonal actions were previously covered in arXiv:2606.13813; equivalently phrased unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: Full bipartition and particle-swap homology of two-point complete-bipartite configurations
